product_metadata.title: mDesign Plastic Bathroom Storage Organizer Caddy Tote, Divided Basket Bin with Handle for Shower, Dorm Room, Holds Soap, Body Wash, Shampoo, Conditioner, Lotion, Lumiere Collection, 2 Pack, Smoke Gray
features: SMART STORAGE: Create space-saving storage in closets, shelves, cabinets, cupboards or on your vanity countertops; Control bathroom clutter and maximize your storage space by organizing go-to essentials in this portable storage organizer; 11 compartments to keep items separated and organized; Store shaving cream, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, body spray, oils, lotions, loofahs, scrub brushes, poufs and more; Set of 2

PORTABLE: The built-in handle makes it easy to transport this tote caddy in and out of cabinets and around the home; Perfect for bathroom shelves, under-sink cabinets, cupboards, and closets; The plastic construction and drainage holes in the base make this a great shower tote for college students or campers; Keep items organized and ready - just grab and go

FUNCTIONAL & VERSATILE: This convenient storage basket is great for other rooms in your home - try them in the bedroom, office, laundry/utility room, kitchen, craft room, kid's rooms, garage and more; The compact size also makes them great for kids rooms, dorms, apartments, RVs, campers and other small spaces; Ideal for men, women, tweens, teens and even toys for your toddler; Storage bins are convenient and useful for keeping clutter under control, and the uses are endless
QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of durable plastic; Drainage holes in bottom of the tote let water flow away to keep items dry; Easy Care - clean with mild soap and water; Do not place in dishwasher
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Each Measures 7" x 14.62" x 5.75" high
description: Streamline and organize bathroom cabinets and closets with this Bathroom Storage Organizer Caddy Tote from mDesign. Eleven divided sections of varying sizes provide plenty of space to store loofahs, body wash, face scrub, brushes, perfume, and more. The built-in handle makes moving this tote in and out of cabinets simple and easy. The open top lets you see what's stored inside and grab what you need. Modern living by design.
